explanation: Batman first appeared in Detective Comics in 1939. That title gave the publisher its name: the DC in DC Comics stands for Detective Comics.

claims.text: Bruce Wayne is Batman's secret identity.
Superman, Iron Man and Green Lantern have other secret identities, such as Clark Kent and Tony Stark.
Batman first appeared in Detective Comics issue 27, in 1939.
The DC in DC Comics comes from the title Detective Comics.
